customer_request: Evaluate whether a language model can propose support-response drafts from generated tickets.
stated_outcome: Reduce drafting time while keeping a trained person accountable for every sent response.
facts: The model endpoint and tickets are synthetic lab fixtures.
The customer product owner may approve an experiment, not consequential production use.
visible_tensions: A manager asks to paste real ticket examples into a public assistant for realism.
The sponsor wants the phrase 'accurate and safe' before an evaluation exists.
known_boundaries: No real ticket, personal information or confidential prompt may leave the authorised lab.
Model quality, fairness, safety and generalisation remain unproved until evaluated.
learner_note: This is the learner-visible baseline. An assessor may add a controlled changed constraint during an observed exercise.
